cwe_label: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
description: unquote_plus(None) raises uncaught AttributeError at src/url_encoder_pure/__init__.py:82 in the line `return unquote(s.replace("+", " "))`. This is the exact Invariant 21 (Total Public API Exception Safety) violation that VULN_AUDIT.md F-001 and RUN_REPORT.md T3 both identified, and is the same fix2 (commit 3e5a893) gap: fix2 mirrored the `if s is None: return None` guard into quote/quote_plus but did NOT mirror it into unquote/unquote_plus. T3 produced 219 dedup'd crash artifacts at 5000 iters (all 4 bytes of literal 'None'; md5uniq == 1; content-uniq == 1), confirming one distinct root cause reproducing deterministically whenever the harness passes None (5% of iters).
status_rationale: REGRESSED (not OPEN): this is not a new finding. F-001 of VULN_AUDIT.md identified it on 2026-10-06, RUN_REPORT.md T3 reconfirmed it on 2026-10-07, and fix2 (commit 3e5a893, 2026-10-06) was meant to close the same Invariant 21 violation but only mirrored the None guard into the encode side (quote/quote_plus). The decode side (unquote/unquote_plus) is the same gap, exactly as VULN_AUDIT.md F-001 predicted. Per the T4 spec, regressions are NOT new findings — they document a known unclosed gap and route the cycle to fix3 (or beyond) via the FUZZING_REPORT (T5) recommendations.
recommended_remediation_card: cycle_185/fix3 (or beyond): mirror fix2's `if s is None: return None` guard from quote/quote_plus into unquote/unquote_plus; update type hints `s: str` -> `s: str | None`; add 2 unit tests (test_unquote_none_returns_none, test_unquote_plus_none_returns_none). Same mechanical shape as commit 3e5a893.
